cards.title: Ask the price of this item

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.en: How much does this shirt cost?

cards.title: Move the size and try it

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.en: Do you have a larger size?

cards.title: Ask the exchange rule before paying

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.es: ¿La puedo cambiar si no me queda?
exchange.en: Can I exchange it if it doesn’t fit me?

exchange.speaker: staff
exchange.es: Sí, con el recibo y la etiqueta.
exchange.en: Yes, with the receipt and the tag.

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.en: How many days do I have to exchange it?

exchange.speaker: traveler
exchange.en: I want to exchange it for another size.

exchange.speaker: staff
exchange.en: Do you have the receipt and the tag?
